items.title: Russia’s Election Result Won’t Be a Shock. What Comes Next Could Be.
items.summary: Russians are braced for what may follow for the military and economy after a parliamentary election that the Kremlin sees as a means of legitimizing its policies.

items.imageAlt: An ad for the United Russia party in Moscow on Tuesday. A three-day election will offer little formal outlet for voters to register discontent over the growing reverberations of the war in Ukraine.
